Our Story

Elegance Rooted in Faith

Vail of Gheera creates premium Islamic lifestyle products that combine modesty, quality craftsmanship, and timeless Islamic calligraphy.

Every embroidered cap, school bag, and tote bag is designed to remind Muslims of Allah while embracing elegance. From the softest fabrics to the most delicate stitchwork — we believe modesty is the highest form of beauty.
